source_census: 24 official public writeups read in full, plus selected author code

proposals.decision: Keep RGB content separate from grid evidence and geometric validity
proposals.motivation: No grid evidence is not evidence that the underlying RGB or trace does not exist
proposals.implementation_candidate: Return RGB, source sampling map, evidence support, geometric validity and uncertainty as separate fields. Keep original RGB for sampling, even if an enhanced observation branch estimates geometry
proposals.novelty_note: Original-path and crop-based alternatives already exist. The proposed contribution is a rigorously measured preservation contract
proposals.falsification: Erase grid only inside a patch while retaining text, calibration pulse and trace. The corresponding visible RGB must not be blanked solely because grid confidence drops
proposals.do_not_claim: Recovery of occluded content or known mm calibration in a genuinely unobservable region

proposals.decision: Compose global projective geometry with a coupled continuous local field
proposals.implementation_candidate: Preserve global H analytically and fit local residual in the rectified plane. Use one shared map across cells and sample the original RGB once
proposals.novelty_note: High-resolution parameter transfer and one-pass RGB resampling are established prior art
candidate_arms: Global H plus shared bilinear residual
Global H plus shared triangular residual
proposals.falsification: Identity, exact projective input, coordinate ramps, two-cell seam witness, high-curvature sheet and missing boundary support. A seam or fold is a failure even if downstream SNR improves
proposals.do_not_claim: A positive local Jacobian alone establishes global injectivity

proposals.decision: Treat every pixel-origin and corner-alignment convention as part of the method
proposals.novelty_note: The 15th-place publication already describes the endpoint and align_corners repair. M3 independently measured the native half-pixel defect
proposals.implementation_candidate: One explicit continuous coordinate definition, checked conversions for OpenCV and torch, inclusive source pixel-center bounds
proposals.falsification: Identity ramps, all four quarter rotations, odd/even sizes, singleton dimensions where supported, first and last source columns, border support and chained-versus-composed sampling
proposals.do_not_claim: Our sampling repair is new or its downstream clinical benefit has been measured

proposals.decision: Use local K16 homography as a candidate and local geometry prior, not an unconditional default
proposals.implementation_candidate: Evaluate faithful hard-cell K16 against a coupled map that projects local H proposals into shared node or spline parameters. Preserve a separately named native arm
proposals.falsification: Measure one-sided source-coordinate limits at every shared edge, maximum jump, trace discontinuity and fold rate under exact nodes, noisy nodes and sharp creases

known_counterexample.type: Analytic counterexample for independent per-cell H, not checkpoint benchmark
known_counterexample.executed: CPU OpenCV getPerspectiveTransform and perspectiveTransform in existing swarm-venv
known_counterexample.conclusion: Matching the two common endpoint nodes does not guarantee continuous parameterization along a shared projective edge

proposals.limits: K16 may reduce noise and improve average SNR. This witness does not estimate its empirical error on the competition distribution

proposals.decision: Combine point, curve and relative lattice evidence with explicit correspondence hypotheses
proposals.implementation_candidate: Relative row/column offsets, local directions and grid-phase hypotheses, then optional template-specific semantic anchor evidence. Keep disconnected components uncertain until anchored
proposals.falsification: Drop an entire row, shift a disconnected component by one major cell, remove alternate lines, vary minor/major contrast, introduce thick trace crossings and unexpected layouts
proposals.do_not_claim: Fixed absolute row labels are layout-independent observations

proposals.decision: Refine measured locations at high resolution with independent subpixel supervision
proposals.implementation_candidate: Probability-weighted centroids followed by a small patch refiner, with quality and uncertainty estimates. Compare against integer components using the same detector heatmaps
proposals.falsification: Known continuous crossings under blur, asymmetric ink, moire, compression and trace intersections. Check calibration of uncertainty and bias of human labels
proposals.do_not_claim: Waveform parabolic refinement in Tang refines grid point coordinates
proposals.limits: Reported point errors from the 21st-place author are not independent measurements, and manually viewing baseline predictions may anchor labels

proposals.decision: Represent interpolation and extrapolation provenance explicitly
proposals.implementation_candidate: Tag observed, interpolated, extrapolated and unavailable geometry. Never use source[0,0] as a missing sentinel. Track fallback transform and support distance separately
proposals.falsification: Interior holes, outer annuli, asymmetric missing edges and disconnected islands. Report both risk on retained support and error in added support
proposals.do_not_claim: A filled rectangular image proves full metric observability

proposals.decision: Separate clinical orientation, layout and physical scale from lattice shape
proposals.implementation_candidate: Fuse OCR, lead labels, calibration pulses, boundary and acquisition metadata. Preserve multiple D4 or scale hypotheses where cues conflict
proposals.falsification: All eight D4 transforms, blank text, mirrored labels, arbitrary crops, 6x2,12x1,Cabrera and nonstandard paper speed/gain
proposals.do_not_claim: A square grid determines reading direction, reflection or ECG paper speed/gain

proposals.decision: Keep a no-grid direct-crop arm and explicit identity/global fallback
proposals.implementation_candidate: When geometry is underconstrained, preserve original content and pass crop/lead evidence with uncertainty to a common signal extractor. Use a learned expert gate only after held-out calibration
proposals.falsification: Gridless scans, black-white photocopies, saturated glare, camera screenshots, unseen templates and overlapping leads
proposals.do_not_claim: A signal regressor reconstructs a physically correct rectified RGB image or valid calibration when scale is absent

proposals.decision: Train extractors against realistic rectifier errors without using downstream tolerance to excuse wrong geometry
proposals.implementation_candidate: Use predicted OOF geometry and controlled node jitter. Evaluate with both a common frozen extractor and each native extractor. Keep image-warp metrics independent
proposals.falsification: Train/evaluate mismatch in node noise, small systematic phase errors, jitter at corners, high-amplitude signals and fine creases
proposals.do_not_claim: Better SNR automatically means more accurate geometry

proposals.decision: Choose sampling kernel and antialiasing from trace fidelity and local scale
proposals.implementation_candidate: Compare linear, cubic, Lanczos and scale-aware prefiltering with identical maps and original RGB. Respect anisotropic footprint under perspective
proposals.falsification: One-pixel traces, steep QRS slopes, minification, checkerboard/moire, faint lines, sharp step edges and visible crop boundaries
proposals.do_not_claim: Lanczos wins universally because it won one author fold

proposals.decision: Separate authentic teams, matched-observation decoders and derived engineering ablations
proposals.implementation_candidate: Pin source/config/weights. Run authentic compatible-layout pipelines unchanged. Separately compare map decoders on identical detected points. Separately measure image sampling. Keep all failures in denominators
proposals.falsification: A result named as winner reproduction must have winner code/config/weights and faithful positive controls. Native and expanded-format stress lanes must not be merged
minimum_coverage: Native full pipelines where assets exist
CPU and GPU timings only when executed on that hardware
Bootstrap confidence intervals by record or independent capture group
proposals.do_not_claim: Global superiority over Kaggle, npj or commercial systems from our renderer-family synthetic bank

author_ablation_receipt.metric_note: Includes shortII,12.5seconds totalII, and keeps amplitude-out-of-range GT unmodified
author_ablation_receipt.caveat: The additional joint variant is not an isolated geometry-only effect and does not establish clinical-photo superiority
